WITH execution_counts AS (
  SELECT 
    ordersmark,
    COUNT(*) as exec_count
  FROM orderexecutions
  GROUP BY ordersmark
),
with_share AS (
  SELECT 
    ec.ordersmark,
    ec.exec_count,
    CAST(ec.exec_count AS REAL) / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM orderexecutions) as share
  FROM execution_counts ec
),
with_diff AS (
  SELECT 
    ws.ordersmark,
    ws.exec_count,
    ws.share,
    ws.share - (SELECT AVG(share) FROM with_share) as diff
  FROM with_share ws
),
ranked AS (
  SELECT 
    ordersmark,
    exec_count,
    share,
    diff,
    RANK() OVER (ORDER BY diff DESC) as rnk
  FROM with_diff
)
SELECT 
  ordersmark,
  exec_count,
  share,
  diff
FROM ranked
WHERE rnk <= 10
ORDER BY 
  CASE WHEN ordersmark IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END,
  diff DESC;

assumptions.assumption: Executions with NULL ordersmark are grouped together as one group; ranking is independently by difference value (RANK() semantics with ties sharing a rank and later ranks skipping), separate from the secondary sort that pushes NULL ordersmarks to the output's end.
